decisions.reason: The no-code-or-invalid-code trigger is already fully represented by the candidate's message 305 MODIFY.
The source specifies referral-validation popup behavior, not an FAQ revision; the existing no-code FAQ statement remains valid.
The valid-code commission trigger is already fully represented by the candidate's message 305 MODIFY.
The exact valid and blank-or-invalid feedback messages are already represented by the candidate's message 305 MODIFY, while the minted-NFT validity rule was already established.
The requirement that code-used ticket issuance requires a valid referral code is already fully represented by the candidate's message 305 MODIFY.
The source changes referral-validation popup and allocation behavior but does not require a change to the supplied landing-page mechanics copy.
Restricting validity to already minted NFTs does not change the mint-number basis, permanence, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior of referral codes.
Routing the existing $5 commission for invalid-code mints does not change the mint price or revenue-allocation amounts.
The source specifies popup behavior and does not direct an About-page revision; its existing statement about the no-code case remains valid.
Referral-code validation and invalid-code reward routing do not alter certificate delivery, contents, or ebook-access controls.
The source does not change the metadata fields or the rule that an NFT's own mint number supplies its referral-code attribute.
The source does not change referral badge milestones, award conditions, or on-chain badge recording.
